(A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an entertaining game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game (A) [where / which] success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest (B) [highly / high]. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal. Focus on engagement rather than entertainment. The goals of the game play should be interactivity and engagement. Research shows that what makes games instructional (C) [are / is] the level of interactivity and engagement the learners have with the content.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [20]
Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an ① amusing game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be ② evaluated by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and ③ remove multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal. Focus on ④ involvement rather than entertainment.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an entertaining game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal. Focus on engagement rather than entertainment. The goals of the game play should be interactivity and engagement.
① New developers often aim to make learning games entertaining.
② Too many game mechanics may distract learners from educational goals.
③ A mild level of fun can still be included in a learning game.
④ The main purpose of game play is to maximize learners’ enjoyment throughout the activity.
⑤ Learning games should focus on engagement and interactivity rather than entertainment.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’
(A) Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun.
(B) Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes.
(C) Focus on engagement rather than entertainment. The goals of the game play should be interactivity and engagement.

글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? [21]
We are wonderfully created, yet we don't let ourselves take part in the wonder for which we were made. Instead of traveling anywhere and everywhere, most of us use our time moving nowhere at all. We occupy the same square footage of a chair for hours and hours every day. Many kids today are being held captive by ‘smart’ devices like phones and tablets. They are not going outside to play, they are not learning how to socialize and read physical cues from others. ( ① ) As a result they are not learning or building their movement repertoire, the very thing that will help them learn, communicate, create, and become emotionally mature.

다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Learning games need to be what we call ‘fun enough.’ Many new learning-game developers try to design an entertaining game. Unfortunately, that often makes learning harder rather than easier. Remember, you are not creating the next great commercial game to entertain your learners; you are creating a learning game in which success will be measured by the achievement of learning outcomes. Resist the temptation to create a ton of rules, pile on different game elements, and incorporate multiple dynamics to keep player interest high. Yes, the game should be engaging with a mild level of fun, but learning should be the goal.
⑤ Learning games should focus on engagement and interactivity rather than entertainment.

(A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Only when you’re (A) [happy / happily] that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else. You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great benefit to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other sources: you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you. Fellow writers are ideal, but don’t imagine (B) [that / what] any writer will do. If you are part of a writers’ circle or class, you’ll know whose writing you admire, and if you’ve had feedback in the past you’ll know whose opinions (C) [have / do] been helpful.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [20]
Only when you’re ① content that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else. You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great ② advantage to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other ③ sources: you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you. Fellow writers are ④ inappropriate, but don’t imagine that any writer will do. If you are part of a writers’ circle or class, you’ll know whose writing you admire, and if you’ve ⑤ had feedback in the past you’ll know whose opinions have been beneficial ― and whose have not.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Only when you’re happy that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else. You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great benefit to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other sources: you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you. Fellow writers are ideal, but don’t imagine that any writer will do. If you are part of a writers’ circle or class, you’ll know whose writing you admire, and if you’ve had feedback in the past you’ll know whose opinions have been helpful ― and whose have not.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Only when you’re happy that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else.
(A) Therefore, you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you. Fellow writers are ideal, but don’t imagine that any writer will do.
(B) You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great benefit to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other sources.
(C) If you are part of a writers’ circle or class, you’ll know whose writing you admire, and if you’ve had feedback in the past you’ll know whose opinions have been helpful ― and whose have not.

글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? [21]
What seemed like a priority last week when the agenda was crafted is not necessarily the priority right now ― so discussion may branch off in a new direction. Other branches may sprout as some members have urgent phone calls that take them in and out of the meeting. Or sub-groups may form within the room to discuss timely subjects linked in some way to the main meeting trunk. In flexible-time cultures, the effective manager is flexible and professional enough to capitalize on priorities and changing needs as they arise.

다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은? [20]
Only when you’re happy that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else. You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great benefit to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other sources: you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you. Fellow writers are ideal, but don’t imagine that any writer will do.
③ Select reviewers based on their analytical judgment rather than emotional intimacy.
④ While peer authors are suitable, not all of them make appropriate readers.

(주관식) 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 본문에서 찾아 각각 한 단어로 쓰시오. [20]
Only when you’re happy that you’ve done the best you can for your story should you show it to someone else. You may well want to show it to your nearest and dearest, and that’s fine, but in most cases you shouldn’t look to their reading for any great benefit to your work. The most valuable feedback is likely to come from other sources: you should choose readers for their critical insight, not their closeness to you.

(주관식) 다음 우리말을 주어진 조건에 맞게 바르게 영작하시오. [22]
When we are ‘always on’ we are constantly ingesting content ― reading alerts and texts, liking, checking emails, downloading, uploading, upgrading, updating, deleting, submitting responses, and posting. If we do it while we are eating, our multi-tasking is overloading us. As our will attempts to digest the virtual content its forces are diverted from the physical content, our food. It’s easy to eat a sandwich in a minute while talking on the phone.
